localChanges: SKILL.md (Profile, Working rules) and references/case-file.md (every agent prompt): no agent runs the project's full test suite, every command runs in the foreground with no background command, and a reply that holds no path is interim: the lead waits on the agent again and sends one follow-up before starting it afresh. Keep these when porting an upstream change. Decisions 2026-10-25-the-machine-caps-active-builds-and-ci-runs-the-full-suite and 2026-10-25-337-a-child-s-reply-without-its-result-is-interim.
